featured_reviews.name: Abhijeet Bhogale
featured_reviews.review_text:
Good people -Bad Experience – Not Recommended

I visited Prettyvision in February 2025 for an in-house eye check-up. They prescribed me different powers for each eye – one spherical and the other cylindrical – and I got spectacles made there itself for around ₹2000.

Soon after, I started experiencing severe headaches and found the glasses extremely uncomfortable, so I stopped using them.

Recently in December 2025, I consulted a qualified eye specialist, and to my surprise, the correct prescription turned out to be +1.00 spherical for both eyes.

I went back to Prettyvision to get my lenses replaced in the same frame, specifically asking for simple reading glasses. However, I was strongly persuaded to buy progressive lenses costing ₹3600. These lenses were practically unusable for continuous laptop reading – one simply cannot keep tilting the head backward for hours.

When I tried to return them, they refused to give any refund. They on their own fitted reading lenses into my frame ( with so called free of cost). They are good people but I didn't get justice. In total, I ended up spending around ₹5600 just to get a basic near-vision spectacle.

Today, I ordered blue-cut, glare-free plain glasses online for only ₹400. I could have easily got my correct +1.00 spherical glasses with frame for under ₹600.

I have effectively lost around ₹5000 at Prettyvision.

Strongly suggest going for a proper eye specialist and ordering online instead.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Nayan Optics - Kurla, Mumbai

I recently visited Nayan Optics in Kurla, Mumbai, and had an excellent experience. Here's a breakdown of what made my visit so worthwhile:
1. Wide Range of Products
Nayan Optics has an impressive selection of eyewear, including trendy frames, sunglasses, and specialized lenses. They cater to all age groups and preferences, from fashionable frames to functional ones for everyday use. They also offer high-quality lenses like anti-glare, blue-light filtering, and polarized options, which makes it easy to find something suited to both style and eye care needs.
2. Knowledgeable Staff and Personalized Service
The staff at Nayan Optics is highly knowledgeable about their products and the latest eyewear trends. They took the time to understand my specific needs, explain lens options, and suggest frame styles that would complement my face shape. Their recommendations were spot-on, and I felt the focus was on getting the best fit for me rather than simply making a sale.
3. Advanced Eye Testing Facility
One of the best parts of my experience was the advanced eye testing available at the store. The setup is modern, with the latest equipment for accurate and comprehensive eye exams. The optometrists were thorough, explaining each step of the process and ensuring my prescription was exactly right.
4. Competitive Pricing and Deals
Compared to other optical stores, Nayan Optics offers very reasonable pricing, especially considering the quality of products and service. They have various offers and discounts on branded frames and lenses, making it easy to find something that fits within budget without compromising on quality.
5. Quick Turnaround Time
Nayan Optics also impressed me with how quickly they delivered my glasses. Even with custom lenses, they managed to prepare them within a few days, which is great for anyone who needs their eyewear quickly.
6. Clean and Inviting Store Ambience
The store itself is well-organized and welcoming, with a layout that makes browsing easy. They maintain cleanliness and hygiene, which adds to the overall comfort while shopping.
Final Verdict:
Nayan Optics is a fantastic choice for anyone looking for high-quality eyewear in Mumbai. The store combines a great range of products with excellent customer service and competitive prices. I highly recommend Nayan Optics for anyone in the area needing new glasses, lenses, or simply a trusted place for regular eye check-ups.
Good Wishes Team Nayan Optics

featured_reviews.review_text:
I have taken both my husband and my mother to Abhay Jain at Hi-Tech Eye Care, and every single time, the experience has been outstanding.

What I appreciate most about Abhay is that he never makes you feel like just another customer. He makes you feel genuinely attended to and cared for.

My mother is a senior citizen and can be quite particular when it comes to her spectacles. She was confused about what she wanted, had a few concerns even after the purchase, and needed multiple adjustments. But Abhay handled everything with so much patience and warmth. He even sent his team member home more than once to help her, and ensured she was completely satisfied. In fact, he got her spectacles changed as well because he wanted her to be fully convinced before closing the matter.

My husband had also purchased an expensive pair of spectacles from him. Due to an accidental mistake on our end, the frame got damaged while trying to remove some colour stains. Despite that, Abhay helped get the frame replaced, which was truly appreciated.

Apart from being an excellent friend, Abhay is an exceptional service provider. In today’s world, finding someone who genuinely stands behind their product and service is rare, and Abhay does exactly that.

Thank you, Abhay, and the entire team at Hi-Tech Eye Care, for always going the extra mile. Wishing you continued success, many happy customers, and many more years of serving people with the same dedication and care.

featured_reviews.name: Aarti Bajaj
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the worst experience with them. I bought Chanel glasses worth ₹72,000 on 22nd April at Bandra BKC. The salesperson was supposed to give me a fresh pair but quietly handed me the display piece instead. It had major scuff marks, which I noticed the very next day, so I went back to return it. I insisted on an exchange, but obviously they didn’t have another pair available.

They told me the refund would be processed within two weeks. It’s been a month now, and I’m still waiting. I’ve been constantly following up with them, and it’s honestly been exhausting. There is absolutely no accountability. I’ve already provided them with everything they asked for, yet all I keep hearing is “4–5 more days” over and over again.

Their so-called 15-day guarantee/policy is honestly bullshit. It clearly means nothing if customers are still left chasing refunds for over  a month. they don’t even pick up their phones. It’s amazing, how  disgusting a service it has been.

Update .. I was told that I will get my refund by Friday, which is today. Nada.
One month exactly now
